{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''SEMCO Keweenaw Connector Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.michigan.gov/mpsc/commission/news-releases/2025/05/15/mpsc-approves-settlement-agreement-on-new-natural-gas-pipeline|title=michigan.gov|website=michigan.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uppermichiganssource.com/2025/05/16/semco-energys-application-gas-pipeline-baraga-county-moves-forward/|title=uppermichiganssource.com|website=uppermichiganssource.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is proposed to run from Three Lakes, Michigan to Baraga, Michigan.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.michigan.gov/mpsc/commission/news-releases/2025/05/15/mpsc-approves-settlement-agreement-on-new-natural-gas-pipeline|title=michigan.gov|website=michigan.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uppermichiganssource.com/2025/05/16/semco-energys-application-gas-pipeline-baraga-county-moves-forward/|title=uppermichiganssource.com|website=uppermichiganssource.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
